lines: Both states, knowing meditated — the middle resort to:
at once, both left — in middle reality shines forth.
sanskrit_cite: ubhayor bhāvayor jñāne dhyātvā madhyaṃ samāśrayet | yugapac ca dvayaṃ tyaktvā madhye tattvam prakāśate

lines: State abandoned, restrained consciousness goes no-where-else:
then in that middle-being — contemplation expands exceedingly.
sanskrit_cite: bhāve tyakte niruddhā cin naiva bhāvāntaraṃ vrajet | tadā tanmadhyabhāvena vikasatyati bhāvanā

lines: All body consciousness-made, or world, fancy fully:
at once by undivided mind — supreme rise.
sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ dehaṃ cinmayaṃ hi jagad vā paribhāvayet | yugapan nirvikalpena manasā paramodayaḥ

lines: Two winds, clashing, inside or outside at limit:
yogin — of evenness-knowing's rise, the offering-vessel.
sanskrit_cite: vāyudvayasya saṃghaṭṭād antar vā bahir antataḥ | yogī samatvavijñānasamudgamanabhājanam

lines: All world or own body, with own bliss filled, remember:
at once with own nectar — full of supreme bliss may be.
sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ jagat svadehaṃ vā svānandabharitaṃ smaret | yugapat svāmṛtenaiva parānandamayo bhavet

lines: By trick, by application, at once, deer-eyed:
great bliss manifests — by which reality shines.
sanskrit_cite: kuhanena prayogeṇa sadya eva mṛgekṣaṇe | samudeti mahānando yena tattvaṃ prakāśate

lines: Channels all bound, up-breath power, slowly:
at the crawling ant's time — supreme happiness spreads.
sanskrit_cite: sarvasrotonibandhena prāṇaśaktyordhvayā śanaiḥ | pipīlasparśavelāyām prathate paramaṃ sukham

lines: Fire and poison, middle: mind happiness-made cast —
mere wind-filled, or yoked by remembrance-bliss.
sanskrit_cite: vahner viṣasya madhye tu cittaṃ sukhamayaṃ kṣipet | kevalaṃ vāyupūrṇaṃ vā smarānandena yujyate

lines: Agitated by union, shaking, power-penetration's end:
whatever brahman-reality's happiness — self-told, that told.
sanskrit_cite: śaktisaṃgamasaṃkṣubdhaśaktyāveśāvasānikam | yat sukham brahmatattvasya tat sukhaṃ svākyam ucyate

lines: Licking, churning, pounding's apex — woman-bliss from
fullness, from memory: power-absent, bliss-flood may be.
sanskrit_cite: lehanāmanthanākoṭaiḥ strīsukhasya bharāt smṛteḥ | śaktyabhāve 'pi deveśi bhaved ānandasamplavaḥ
